What we offer

Medical services

Everything available at the hospital and at your home, in one place. If you are not sure which service you need, call our desk and we will point you to the right department.

  • OP Consultations

    See a specialist at the hospital. Book a slot online and skip the queue at the desk.

    Book a consultation

  • Home Physiotherapy

    A physiotherapist treats you at home — single visits or session packages for longer recoveries.

    See packages

  • Surgery & Procedures

    Laparoscopic and open surgery, joint replacement, arthroscopy and day-care procedures.

    Explore surgery

  • Second Opinion

    Been advised an operation? Have another specialist review the case, free of charge.

    Request an opinion

  • Diagnostics & Imaging

    X-ray, ultrasound and laboratory services on site, so results reach your doctor the same day.

    About diagnostics

  • Rehabilitation

    Structured recovery programmes after surgery, stroke or injury, run with your treating doctor.

    About rehab

Emergency & ambulance

Available 24 × 7. Do not book online in an emergency — call us.
